In this version, there are no conditions under which the economy will activate. [[Main:Toady One|Toady One]] has stated that it may come back in after sweeping changes are made to make it less broken.

The last version in which the Dwarven economy ''did'' activate was version [[40d:Dwarven economy|0.28.181.40d]].
